value.rationale: This is a complete and natural discrete-dynamical parameter subfamily: the crystallographic root-of-unity denominators are exactly those whose additive step group forms a discrete planar lattice. The study that introduced the walk poses period behavior as a central question under irrational angles. The new theorem gives a sharp full initial-condition answer at the rational boundary, distinguishing q=3/6 coexistence of periods 3 and 6 from rigid periods 2 and 4 at the other denominators; neither a textbook one-dimensional exercise nor an arbitrary isolated numerical case. A geometric trapping lemma and rigorous exact switching-cell census supply reusable structure for piecewise isometric greedy maps.
